defect: The 'Pergerakan Hutang Awam' table prints opening balance, new loans, repayments and closing balance per loan group, with a JUMLAH per group and a JUMLAH KESELURUHAN. The extractor reads it as a balance table and takes the first amount (the OPENING balance) of each JUMLAH line as debt_total for the year, so it disagrees with the 'Kedudukan Hutang Awam' table (J55, J52).
diagnosis: Page-proved 2026-11-04: CMD.49.2023.pdf p85 (J53): opening 17.31 + 14.20 = 31.51, closing 17.31 + 8.13 = 25.44 = J52 FY2022 (p84). CMD.52.2022.pdf p80 (J56): opening 1,084.76 + 20.03 = 1,104.79, closing 17.31 + 14.20 = 31.51 = J55 FY2021 (p79). Every printed figure reconciles; not an AG misprint.
why_unfixed: The movement table must emit opening/closing under their own codes (debt_opening, debt_closing), with only the closing of JUMLAH KESELURUHAN as debt_total; re-extraction runs in states-extract.yml.
impact_on_data: Use debt_total from the Kedudukan Hutang Awam table (is_canonical=yes); the movement-table rows are not a year-end debt figure.

affected_rows: the 'Penyumbang Utama Hasil' rows of CMD.41.2019 (J11) and CMD.50.2021 (J13): year columns paired wrongly
defect: The five-year 'Penyumbang Utama Hasil Kerajaan Negeri' table prints an RM juta column and a (%) column per year, and in the text layer an amount and its share often fall on different lines. The extractor pairs them by position, so a share (often the JUMLAH row's 100.0) is read as an amount and the year columns shift.
why_unfixed: The table parser must pair amounts and shares by column x-position, not by order; re-extraction runs where the PDFs are (states-extract.yml).
impact_on_data: These analysis-table rows are not used by core or the gap view (which use the audited statements); do not read the top-contributor amounts from the current extraction.

impact_on_data: Four `revenue_top_contributors_total` values are unusable.  Every `revenue_item_*` contributor value on this page was checked line by line against the printed page and is correct.

affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: The root fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) was implemented and DELIBERATELY REVERTED: it moved roughly 2,000 rows across all 13 states, raised the refusal count, and degraded the frozen Selangor regression.  It needs its own pass with the column clustering retuned alongside it.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.
